data_sources: static analysis of dist/public build output
live HTTP header and content verification
unavailable_data: CrUX field data (no Google API credentials)
top_findings: Page content is JS-rendered: shipped HTML carries a median of 147 words vs a 91 KB React component, so non-JS crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, CCBot) see only a stub
Zero h2/h3 headings sitewide (heading census is {h1: 24})
/hire-khalid is an orphan conversion page with zero inbound internal links
Zero tags on the entire site, on a portfolio site
non-www does not redirect to www; both return 200 with identical content
quick_wins: Link to /hire-khalid from nav, footer, and service page CTAs
Shorten 2 over-length titles and 2 over-length meta descriptions
Add h2 subheadings to every page section
Add non-www to www 301 redirect in vercel.json
Expand the SSG text stub to mirror real page sections

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: robots.txt explicitly allows AI crawlers with per-agent rules
Sitemap complete and valid: 22 URLs, all returning 200
Canonicals correct and consistent (www, no trailing slash) on all 24 real pages
No duplicate titles or descriptions anywhere
HTTPS enforced via Vercel

findings.title: non-www does not redirect to www
findings.description: https://theweb3wizard.xyz/about returns 200 with no Location header. Both hostnames serve byte-identical content (6485 bytes).
findings.recommendation: Add a host-based 301 redirect to vercel.json.

findings.title: Trailing-slash and non-slash URLs both return 200
findings.description: /about and /about/ both return 200 with identical bytes. Same for all service and work pages.
findings.recommendation: Set trailingSlash: false in vercel.json.

findings.title: Inconsistent sitemap lastmod dates
findings.description: lastmod values of 2026-09-08, 2026-09-28 and 2026-10-17 coexist.
findings.recommendation: Generate lastmod from actual build or content change times.

findings.title: /privacy and /terms absent from sitemap
findings.description: Both pages are indexable but excluded from all 22 sitemap entries.
findings.recommendation: Either include them or add noindex.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: E-E-A-T positioning is unusually honest: explicitly refuses invented metrics and 'trusted by' claims
Real proof assets: named projects with live demos and linked repositories
Clear scope boundaries and exclusions stated per service

findings.title: Actual page content absent from shipped HTML
findings.description: Measured word counts across 24 pages: min 120, median 147, max 176. Real content lives in a 91,741-byte React component rendered client-side.
findings.recommendation: Expand the SSG stub to mirror real page content so non-JS crawlers receive the full text.

findings.title: Insight articles are the thinnest valuable asset
findings.description: All three /insights/* posts are 167-176 words in HTML.
findings.recommendation: Expand to 1500-2500 words with h2/h3 structure.

findings.title: Zero outbound citations sitewide
findings.description: Every page reports external=0; all 12-17 links per page are internal.
findings.recommendation: Add 2-4 primary-source citations per article.

findings.title: Service pages too thin for commercial keywords
findings.description: Service pages are 146-169 words in HTML.
findings.recommendation: Expand to 800-1500 words covering process, fit, timeline, proof and objections.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Titles unique, keyword-front-loaded and consistently branded
Descriptions unique and correctly sized on 22 of 24 pages
Clean single-h1-per-page discipline

findings.title: No subheadings on any page
findings.description: Heading census across 25 pages returns {h1: 24}. Zero h2-h6 elements exist sitewide.
findings.recommendation: Add h2 per section and h3 per sub-section, without skipping levels.

findings.title: /hire-khalid orphaned
findings.description: Scanning every anchor across all 25 pages, the only occurrence of 'hire-khalid' is that page's own canonical tag. Zero inbound internal links.
findings.recommendation: Add to primary nav, footer, and service page CTAs with descriptive anchor text.

findings.title: Title exceeds 60 characters
findings.description: /hire-khalid title is 66 characters.
findings.recommendation: Shorten to under 60.

findings.title: Title exceeds 60 characters
findings.description: /profile title is 61 characters.
findings.recommendation: Shorten to under 60.

findings.title: Meta description exceeds 160 characters
findings.description: /ai-agents description is 178 characters.
findings.recommendation: Trim to 160 or fewer, front-loading value.

findings.title: Meta description exceeds 160 characters
findings.description: /profile description is 161 characters.
findings.recommendation: Trim to 160 or fewer.

findings.title: Non-descriptive navigation anchors
findings.description: Nav anchor text is Home, Services, Work, Insights, About, Contact.
findings.recommendation: Use topical anchors where layout allows.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: All JSON-LD parsed with zero syntax errors
Person on 24 pages, BreadcrumbList on 21
Type-appropriate coverage: Service, SoftwareApplication, Article, ProfessionalService, WebSite, FAQPage

findings.title: FAQPage only on homepage
findings.description: Only 1 FAQPage block exists across the site.
findings.recommendation: Add 4-6 question FAQ blocks with FAQPage schema to each service page.

findings.title: No Organization entity
findings.description: Person exists sitewide but no Organization node with sameAs links.
findings.recommendation: Add Organization with sameAs to GitHub, LinkedIn and X.

findings.title: Article schema lacks authorship and dates
findings.description: The 3 Article blocks do not link author to the Person entity or declare dates.
findings.recommendation: Add author @id, datePublished and dateModified.

findings.title: No Service to Person linkage
findings.description: Service nodes do not declare a provider referencing the Person entity.
findings.recommendation: Wire Service.provider to the Person @id.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: No images in HTML means no image-driven LCP cost
SiteSearch is code-split into its own 48 KB chunk

findings.title: Provisional score - not measured
findings.description: No Playwright render, no CrUX field data and no PageSpeed credentials were available. Score is inferred from payload composition only.
findings.recommendation: Run PageSpeed Insights on /, /services/web3-mvp-development and /hire-khalid to complete this category.

findings.title: ~672 KB of JS and CSS for ~150 words of HTML
findings.description: vendor 225 KB + index 187 KB + css 127 KB + data 85 KB + SiteSearch 48 KB. Heavy for a content surface.
findings.recommendation: Audit bundle after content is moved into HTML; consider reducing client-side JS on marketing pages.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: robots.txt explicitly allows GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, anthropic-ai, PerplexityBot and Google-Extended
Person schema sitewide gives AI systems a stable entity anchor
Some copy is specific and quotable

findings.title: Permitted AI crawlers receive only a stub
findings.description: Crawlers that do not execute JavaScript receive the ~150-word div#root fallback rather than the real page content, so the robots.txt invitation is largely unrealised.
findings.recommendation: Deliver full content in the static HTML (same fix as the Content Quality critical finding).

findings.title: No llms.txt
findings.description: /llms.txt is not present.
findings.recommendation: Add an llms.txt listing key pages with one-line descriptions.

findings.title: No extractable passage structure
findings.description: Zero h2/h3 means there are no passage boundaries for AI Overviews or answer engines to extract.
findings.recommendation: Introduce h2/h3 structure so content can be quoted at passage granularity.

findings.title: No Organization entity or sameAs graph
findings.description: Entity resolution relies on Person alone.
findings.recommendation: Add Organization with sameAs to strengthen brand grounding.

findings.title: Insight content too thin to be citation-worthy
findings.description: Articles are 167-176 words, which is below the depth AI systems preferentially cite.
findings.recommendation: Expand articles with specific, developed claims.

findings.title: No definitional sentences
findings.description: Copy is benefit-led rather than definitional, reducing extractability.
findings.recommendation: Add one clear definition sentence per key concept.

categories.name: Images
what_works: Favicons correctly configured in SVG and PNG
One WebP asset present at 169 KB

findings.title: Zero img elements sitewide
findings.description: Programmatic scan of all 25 pages found 0 images, 0 alt attributes, 0 srcset and 0 lazy-loading on a portfolio site.
findings.recommendation: Add real project screenshots with descriptive alt text, width/height, and lazy loading below the fold.

findings.title: One shared OG image across 24 pages
findings.description: All pages point og:image and twitter:image at the same og-image.png.
findings.recommendation: Generate per-project and per-article social cards.

findings.title: Unused profile image
findings.description: /images/khalid-murtala.webp exists at 169 KB but is referenced by no img tag.
findings.recommendation: Use it on /about and /profile with explicit dimensions.

findings.title: OG image likely undersized
findings.description: og-image.png is 20 KB, likely below the 1200x630 ideal for large social cards.
findings.recommendation: Verify dimensions and re-export in WebP/AVIF at 1200x630.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Expand the SSG text stub so full content is present in static HTML
Add h2/h3 heading structure to every page
Link to /hire-khalid from nav, footer and service CTAs
Add non-www to www 301 redirect and set trailingSlash false in vercel.json

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Expand all three insight articles to 1500-2500 words
Add real project screenshots with alt text and dimensions
Add 2-4 outbound primary-source citations per article

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Add FAQPage schema to service pages
Strengthen Article schema with author and dates

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Run PageSpeed Insights to complete the Performance category
Capture an seo-drift baseline before changes

not_findings: /googlea2084a1162bab0e0/ is a Google Search Console verification file; its missing title, canonical and OG tags are expected
/privacy and /terms absent from sitemap is normal
Missing keywords meta tag is obsolete and ignored
AMP has no ranking benefit and should not be added
